headline: Gilead Sciences (GILD) Following Trodelvy Progress And A Fair Value Debate
summary: Gilead Sciences (GILD) is back in focus after regulators in Europe issued a positive opinion on expanding Trodelvy’s use alongside Keytruda for certain advanced triple negative breast cancer patients. See our latest analysis for Gilead Sciences. Alongside the positive Trodelvy opinion, Gilead Sciences shares have seen a 5.07% 30 day share price return and a 9.15% year to date share price return, while the 5 year total shareholder return of 130.07% reflects strong longer term compounding.
